rationale: Nine of the ten individuals newly designated as part of the Tren de Aragua (FTO/TCO) financial network carry a TRX (Tron) 'Digital Currency Address' identifier (page 1-2), consistent with CMI010 Cryptocurrency Evasion -- use of virtual-asset wallets to move value for a sanctioned network after the theft of funds from U.S. banks described in the release's own title (page 1).

citations.quote: Treasury Sanctions Financial Network of Foreign Terrorist Organization, Tren de Aragua, After Theft of Millions from U.S. Banks

rationale: Two Mexican entities, Enigma Community S. de R.L. de C.V. and Soluciones Integrales Toluca S.A. de C.V., were newly designated solely on the basis of being 'Linked To' individual Tren de Aragua network members (page 2), matching SAN004's description of a front company established 'to give a sanctioned interest a clean commercial face.' Enigma Community's declared business type ('Other education n.e.c.') bears no relation to its Tlalnepantla, Mexico address or its TCO linkage, a generic/mismatched business description typical of SAN004 front companies.
